g.text: Hour-based source selection; injected trajectories retain their complete tails and may extend beyond the source hour.

g.text: Cutoffs are inherited outcome-selected peaks (included), not validated operating limits. Full ranges and unavailable scenes appear in the companion report.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526472

g.text: No smoothing or new D fits. Missing values break lines. Means use available orders; R² ≥ 0.98 unchanged. Equal-duration control is reported separately.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526472

g.text: Baseline-valid subset: 14/15 positive order coefficients, median ρ = 0.800. Orders are dependent repeats; the response is not uniformly monotonic.
